ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
The adjacent map is part of a city: the small rectangles are rocks, and the paths in between are streets. Each morning, a student walks from intersection A to intersection B, always walking along streets shown, and always going east or south. For variety, at each intersection where he has a choice, he chooses with probability $\frac{1}{2}$ whether to go east or south. Find the probability that through any given morning, he goes through $C$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a grid composed of rectangular obstacles and streets between them; the compass shows that to the right is east and downward is south. A is located at an intersection in the upper left; from A to the right to the eastern vertical street containing C and B, there are 3 eastward street steps; from A downward to B, there are 4 southward street steps. C is on this eastern vertical street, located at the position 3 steps east and 3 steps south from A, and B is one grid directly south of C, that is, 3 steps east and 4 steps south. Reasoning: According to the method, set coordinates (i,j), where i is the number of steps walked east from A, and j is the number of steps walked south from A, A=(0,0), C=(3,3), B=(3,4). Let h(i,j) be the probability of ultimately passing through C starting from intersection (i,j). The boundary conditions are h(3,3)=1; on the east boundary and above C, h(3,0)=h(3,1)=h(3,2)=1, because one can only go south and ultimately pass through C; on the bottom boundary and west of B, h(0,4)=h(1,4)=h(2,4)=0, because afterward one can only go east to B and will not pass through C. For an interior point, if one can go either east or south, then h(i,j)=(h(i+1,j)+h(i,j+1))/2. Calculate from the lower right to the upper left: when j=3, h(2,3)=1/2, h(1,3)=1/4, h(0,3)=1/8; when j=2, h(2,2)=3/4, h(1,2)=1/2, h(0,2)=5/16; when j=1, h(2,1)=7/8, h(1,1)=11/16, h(0,1)=1/2; when j=0, h(2,0)=15/16, h(1,0)=13/16, h(0,0)=(13/16+1/2)/2=21/32. Therefore the probability of passing through C starting from A is 21/32.

method.method_draft: Describe the image as a rectangular street lattice: from A to the vertical street containing C and B there are 3 eastward street steps, and from A down to B there are 4 southward street steps. C is on the eastern boundary at position 3 east and 3 south from A, one street step north of B. Label intersections by coordinates (i,j), where i is the number of east moves from A and j is the number of south moves. Define h(i,j) to be the probability of eventually going through C starting from that intersection. Use boundary values h(3,3)=1, h(i,4)=0 for i=0,1,2 because once the walker reaches the bottom row west of B he is forced east to B without passing C, and h(3,j)=1 for j=0,1,2 because on the eastern boundary above C he is forced south through C. For interior intersections use h(i,j)=(h(i+1,j)+h(i,j+1))/2, since the text says he chooses east or south with probability 1/2 when both are available. Fill the table backward from the bottom and right edges to obtain h(0,0)=21/32.

method.method_draft: Use a stopping-time enumeration from the image. Treat A as coordinate (0,0), B as (3,4), and C as (3,3). The walker avoids C exactly if he reaches the bottom row j=4 before ever reaching the eastern boundary i=3; after that he is forced east to B and cannot pass through C. Therefore count the random choice sequences whose fourth south move occurs before the third east move. The final free choice in such a sequence is S, and before it there must be exactly 3 south moves and e east moves, where e=0,1,2. Thus P(avoid C)=sum_{e=0}^{2} binom(3+e,e)(1/2)^{4+e}=1/16+4/32+10/64=11/32. Hence P(goes through C)=1-11/32=21/32.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中街道形成一个向东、向南可行的网格区域；A 在左上方的起点交叉口，B 在右下侧的终点交叉口，C 在与 B 同一条最东侧竖直街道上、位于 B 上方一个交叉口的位置。按图中方向标，东是向右，南是向下。依照方法草稿，把 A 记为坐标 (0,0)，B 记为 (3,4)，C 记为 (3,3)。

推理：学生只能向东或向南走。若他先到达最东边界 i=3，那么之后沿街道向南到 B 时一定会经过 C=(3,3)。所以“不经过 C”的情况恰好是：在到达最东边界 i=3 之前，先到达最下面一行 j=4；之后他只能向东到 B，不会经过 C。

因此要数第四次向南 S 出现在第三次向东 E 之前的随机选择序列。使其避免 C 的最后一次自由选择必须是第 4 个 S；在这之前已有恰好 3 个 S，并且 E 的个数 e 可以是 0、1、2。

所以
P(避免 C)=∑_{e=0}^{2} C(3+e,e)(1/2)^{4+e}
= C(3,0)/2^4 + C(4,1)/2^5 + C(5,2)/2^6
= 1/16 + 4/32 + 10/64
= 11/32。

于是
P(经过 C)=1-11/32=21/32。
